{{Quote|With unrest a constant problem on peripheral Imperial holdings such as Sappire and Dakshee, experts do not expect the Emperor to remain neutral.|A news report by [[Imperial HoloVision]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]|<ref name="GNN5" />}}
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], in the wake of the [[Dentaal Uprising]] of [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dakshee]] was the site of an '''uprising''' that was violently reprimanded by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

The classical [[Actor/Legends|actress]] [[Dana Meimonda]] was present on Dakshee during the subjugation of her [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]. She escaped the massacre and went on to become a [[Spy/Legends|spy]] for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] on [[Esseles/Legends|Esseles]].

==Prelude==
During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]], the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dakshee]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Barma sector/Legends|Barma sector]] within the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]],<ref name="KKT">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=swminis/article/kylekatarnstale|series=Kyle Katarn's Tale|text=Mission 1}}</ref> remained a long [[Time/Legends|time]] under the rule of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="CSWE-Dakshee">{{CSWECite|I|162|Dakshee}}</ref> However, the planet was marked by constant unrest,<ref name="GNN5" /> to the point that it was considered a problem world for the Empire.<ref name="GNN7">{{JournalCite|7|Galaxywide NewsNets}}</ref>

During the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] transmitted [[Propaganda/Legends|propaganda]] broadcasts to the restless population of Dakshee from a secret base in the nearby [[AX system]].<ref name="KKT" />

At the start of the [[Dentaal Uprising]], in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] news network [[Imperial HoloVision]] reported that [[Politics/Legends|political]] experts were expecting [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] to take action against Imperial-held worlds with a constant unrest problem, such as Dakshee and [[Sappire]].<ref name="GNN5" />

==The uprising==
Eventually, at some point between 0 ABY<ref name="GNN5" /> and [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], Dakshee became the site of an uprising.<ref name="HR" />

The Empire responded to the uprising by bringing [[Tarkin Doctrine/Legends|terror]] to the world. During the subjugation of Dakshee, the Empire bombarded the planet first, and then went on to conduct mass executions among the civilian population.<ref name="HR" />

The classical [[Actor/Legends|actress]] [[Dana Meimonda]] was present on Dakshee when the Empire subjugated her [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]].<ref name="HR" /> Meimonda and her [[Dana Meimonda's husband|husband]] were among the very few to escape the massacre,<ref name="HR" /> and both fled to [[Esseles/Legends|Esseles]],<ref name="CSWE-Meimonda">{{CSWECite|II|303|Meimonda, Dana}}</ref> the capital of the [[Darpa sector/Legends|Darpa sector]] within the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="TFOP">''[[The Far Orbit Project]]''</ref>

==Aftermath==
After escaping the subjugation of Dakshee, Meimonda became a Rebel [[Spy/Legends|spy]] on Esseles. Under the guise of a socialite and [[entertainer]], she toured the Imperial installations of Esseles and performed for the [[Troop/Legends|troops]] stationed there.<ref name="HR" /> She became a formidable [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|intelligence]] source regarding troop movements and played a key role in bringing down [[Griff Takel]],<ref name="TFOP" /> the governor of Esseles, and [[Jander Graffe]],<ref name="TFOP" /> the [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] of the Darpa [[Sector/Legends|sector]].<ref name="HR" />

Eventually, after the [[Death/Legends|death]] of Emperor Palpatine at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in 4 ABY, Meimonda openly declared her allegiance to the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and became one of its leading morale boosters.<ref name="HR" />
